segments.zh: 还要确保你的工作区域整洁。你应该时不时退后一步检查你的

segments.zh: 工作空间。把不用的玻璃器皿和设备收起来，避免在台面上放着装有不需要的

segments.zh: 化学品的容器。为了保持工作空间整洁，化学废弃物一产生就要

segments.zh: 丢掉之后还要用的化学品。在实验室里使用实验记录本、电脑、

segments.zh: 手机或计算器时，一定要让它们远离可能

segments.zh: 损坏或污染它们的化学品。保护计算器和手机的一种方法是把它们放进

segments.zh: 塑料袋里。现在我们来看两种常见的实验技术，以及如何降低与之相关的

segments.text: A pipette is often used to measure a known amount of the solution to be analyzed,
segments.zh: 移液管常用于量取一定量的待分析溶液，

segments.zh: 也称为被分析物。为了安全地把移液管连接到洗耳球上，

segments.text: grasp the pipette close to the end and gently insert it into the bulb.
segments.zh: 要握住移液管靠近末端的地方，轻轻插入洗耳球。

segments.text: Applying too much force can break the pipette, which can result in serious injury.
segments.zh: 用力过大可能会折断移液管，造成严重伤害。

segments.text: It's important not to place the pipette into the bottle of stock solution to avoid contamination.
segments.zh: 重要的是不要把移液管直接插入储备溶液瓶中，以免造成污染。

segments.text: Obtain 10% more than you need in your beaker and pipette from the beaker.
segments.zh: 在烧杯中取比所需量多 10% 的溶液，然后从烧杯中移取。

segments.text: Any excess should not go back into the stock solution again to avoid contamination.
segments.zh: 任何多余的溶液都不应倒回储备溶液中，以免造成污染。

segments.text: If you have leftover titrant or analyte, you can offer to share this with a lab mate,
segments.zh: 如果你有剩余的滴定剂或被分析物，可以分给实验伙伴使用，

segments.text: otherwise dispose of it in the proper waste container.
segments.zh: 否则就把它倒入相应的废液容器中。

segments.text: Chemical synthesis is another common lab experiment with both chemical and procedural hazards.
segments.zh: 化学合成是另一种常见的实验，同时存在化学危害和操作程序上的危害。

segments.text: A common process is to mix solutions of chemicals, heat, and stir the mixture to produce a precipitate,
segments.zh: 一个常见的过程是混合化学品溶液，加热并搅拌混合物以生成沉淀，

segments.text: and isolate the precipitate by filtration. To start a chemical synthesis, you may need to
segments.zh: 然后通过过滤分离出沉淀。开始化学合成时，你可能需要

segments.zh: 称量试剂。把你的反应烧瓶和记录本带到天平旁。

segments.text: Obtain the desired amount of each solid and small increments. If you get too much at first,
segments.zh: 少量多次地取出每种固体所需的量。如果一开始取多了，

segments.zh: 把多余的放入废物容器中，以免可能污染原试剂。

segments.text: If you spill any solid at the balance, clean this up immediately and put the spilled solid

segments.zh: 废物容器。称好的固体要立即放入烧瓶中，而不要

segments.zh: 把固体放在称量纸上穿过拥挤的实验室。

segments.zh: 对于在水中进行的反应，通常在电热板上加热。使用任何电气

segments.text: Typically, your lab instructor will take care of this or show you how to do so.

segments.text: As noted earlier, at the end of an experiment, you often have leftover solids, solvents, or solutions.

segments.text: In this video, we covered some common techniques for minimizing risks in the lab.
